name: Year Zero Engine spells
description: The general spells and the spells of the seven magic disciplines (Awareness, Healing, Shapeshifting, Blood Magic, Death Magic, Elementalism and Symbolism) from chapter 5 of the Year Zero Engine Standard Reference Document by Fria Ligan AB, summarised in our own words for Forbidden Lands, with page references to the SRD. This game is not affiliated with, sponsored, or endorsed by Fria Ligan AB. entities.name: Magical Seal
entities.description: Wards one person or a spot no bigger than a person. Any spell cast at it while the seal holds loses power levels equal to the seal's power level.

Stats.Effect: Lowers spells against the target by the power level

entities.name: Sense Magic
entities.description: Casters feel magic used nearby or held in their hands anyway; this spell tells what kind it is. It also finds obscured magic if its power level is at least that of the Obscure Magic.

Stats.Effect: Learn what magic is at work

entities.name: Dispel Magic
entities.description: A reaction that cuts in on the initiative order. The enemy spell loses power levels equal to this one's, and does nothing at zero. Both casters roll for overcharge and mishaps; choose your Willpower before either rolls.

Stats.Effect: Lowers another spell by the power level

entities.name: Obscure Magic
entities.description: Hides another spell as you cast it. It costs one more Willpower that adds no power, and is not an action of its own. Only Sense Magic can find the hidden spell.

Stats.Effect: Cast a spell unnoticed for 1 extra Willpower

entities.name: Bind Magic
entities.description: Locks another spell, not a ritual, into an object as a trap or artifact, triggered as you choose. Extra Willpower counts for the dice but not the power level: 1 keeps it a day, 2 keeps it until triggered, 5 makes it permanent and usable once a day for Willpower equal to its power level.

Stats.Effect: Store a spell in an object

entities.name: Transfer
entities.description: For one Willpower, take or give any amount of Willpower. A target who resists limits the amount to the power level. The casting cost itself is not passed on.

Stats.Effect: Move Willpower between you and another

entities.name: Lightbringer
entities.description: Calls up a light that drives away every shadow in the zone you stand in.

Stats.Effect: Bright light fills your zone

entities.name: True Sight
entities.description: Your sight becomes so keen that things at Extreme range look close. You see in the dark and through smoke, fog, disguises and shapeshifts, as long as you have line of sight.

Stats.Effect: See far, in darkness and through disguises

entities.name: Words on the Wind
entities.description: Pick a place you can see and hear what happens there as if you stood in it.

Stats.Effect: Hear sounds far away

entities.name: Farsight
entities.description: Your mind's eye travels to a place you know of and watches it now. Power 1 reaches Long range, 2 about ten kilometres, 3 anywhere. A place you have never visited needs two more. The GM decides what the hazy visions show.

Stats.Effect: See a distant place you know

entities.name: True Path
entities.description: Facing a hard choice, you cast this and the GM tells you which option they think is wisest.

Stats.Effect: The GM names the wisest choice

entities.name: Visions of the Past
entities.description: Glimpse past events at your location. Power 1 looks back a day, 2 a year, 3 centuries. The GM decides what the broken visions show.

Stats.Effect: See what happened here long ago

entities.name: Divination
entities.description: A ritual that shows things to come. Ask the GM questions about yourself or someone present; the short answers are often riddles, or omens of luck or doom.

Stats.Effect: Ask the GM about the future

entities.name: Intuition
entities.description: Ask one yes-or-no question about anything. The GM answers yes, no or maybe and may not lie, though maybe is allowed when the truth would wreck the game. Truth depends on who asks.

Stats.Effect: A yes, no or maybe answer

entities.name: Telepathy
entities.description: Read someone's surface thoughts for a few minutes; older memories need more power. You can also send thoughts, at Long range to someone you know well, and painful ones inflict stress equal to the power level. No effect on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Read thoughts, send them, or inflict stress

entities.name: Cleanse Spirit
entities.description: Nature's light soothes a troubled mind, healing stress (Wits or Empathy) equal to the power level. Not on yourself.

Stats.Effect: Heal Wits or Empathy equal to the power level

entities.name: Healing Hands
entities.description: Lay hands on someone hurt to heal damage (Strength or Agility) equal to the power level. It does not touch critical injuries, and not on yourself.

Stats.Effect: Heal Strength or Agility equal to the power level

entities.name: Nature's Cure
entities.description: Ends a sickness or poison in yourself or another. The power level must be at least its virulence or toxicity divided by three, rounded down.

Stats.Effect: Cure a disease or poison

entities.name: Banish Demon
entities.description: Hurts a demon by the power level, even one that weapons cannot harm.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level on a demon

entities.name: Mend Wounds
entities.description: Knits bones and closes wounds, healing one critical injury at once. A lethal one needs power 2. Lost limbs stay lost.

Stats.Effect: Heal a critical injury

entities.name: Purge Undead
entities.description: Strikes one undead for damage equal to the power level.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level on an undead

entities.name: Resurrection
entities.description: Returns a dead person to true life. Power 1 works within the shift of death, 2 within a day, 3 within a week; after that it is too late. The returned lose one Empathy for good.

Stats.Effect: Bring the dead back to life

entities.name: Serenity
entities.description: Calm and harmony make the target go along with you, with no roll to persuade them. Only on living humanoids.

Stats.Effect: A living humanoid does what you ask

entities.name: Weathermaster
entities.description: Shifts the local weather. A small change needs power 1, strong weather fit for the season power 2, and weather against the season power 3.

Stats.Effect: Change the weather

entities.name: Animal Speech
entities.description: Talk with a mammal and ask questions up to the power level. It tells what it saw, heard or smelled, in a beast's terms that are hard to read, but it never lies.

Stats.Effect: Ask a mammal as many questions as the power level

entities.name: Cat's Paw
entities.description: Move as silently as a cat. Cast it in place of a Stealth roll; it succeeds, with one success per power level.

Stats.Effect: Automatic Stealth, one success per power level

entities.name: Hawk's Eye
entities.description: Share a hawk's sight and make out every detail within Extreme range, enough to tell people apart.

Stats.Effect: See every detail out to the horizon

entities.name: Beastmaster
entities.description: Bend one animal to your will: call off an attack, track, carry a message, bear a rider or fight. Its Strength can be at most twice the power level, and you need one more power if it is upset or fighting, or for tricks it would never do. Not on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Command an animal

entities.name: Bear's Claw
entities.description: Strike with a bear's might. The blow always lands and can't be parried or dodged, dealing damage equal to the power level; armour still counts.

Stats.Effect: Automatic hit, damage equal to the power level

entities.name: Deer's Dash
entities.description: Sprint like a deer: a fast move as an animal, with the power level added to the Move roll. Casting is not an action; roll for overcharge and mishap just before you run.

Stats.Effect: Move like an animal with +power level

entities.name: Animal Form
entities.description: Become an animal with Strength up to twice the power level, taking its Strength, Agility and natural attacks. You can't speak, and Wits and Empathy drop to 1. Cast it again to change back.

Stats.Effect: Turn into an animal

entities.name: Primal Soul
entities.description: Stir up a beast's mood in someone whose Wits is at most the power level, such as rage, sloth or fear; the GM decides how they act. A small crowd needs power 2, a large one 3, a village 4.

Stats.Effect: Wake a primal mood in someone

entities.name: Firewalker
entities.description: Heat and cold no longer harm you, and fire does no damage.

Stats.Effect: Immune to heat, cold and fire

entities.name: Stir Blood
entities.description: Heats the victim's blood with a strong feeling they must act on somehow, as the GM decides. No use in combat or on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Fill someone with lust, fear or rage

entities.name: Bind Demon
entities.description: Forces a demon to obey. It resists with Insight, minus the power level. Demons take badly to being bound.

Stats.Effect: Make a demon serve you

entities.name: Blood Bond
entities.description: Move attribute points equal to the power level between you and another of your kind, never above the starting score. An unwilling target resists with Insight minus the power level. It can raise someone broken, but does nothing for critical injuries.

Stats.Effect: Move attribute points equal to the power level

entities.name: Immolate
entities.description: The victim's blood boils into flame: damage equal to the power level, then fire with an intensity of twice the power level. Armour does not help.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level, then fire

entities.name: Blood Channeling
entities.description: Draws on your own blood for Willpower equal to twice the power level, lost if not used next round. A sacrifice, even a small animal, must die before you cast.

Stats.Effect: Gain twice the power level in Willpower for a round

entities.name: Blood Curse
entities.description: Curses a living humanoid whose name and rough location you know. They take damage or stress to any attribute, one point per shift, up to the power level, and can't heal naturally meanwhile.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level, one point per shift

entities.name: Bind Soul
entities.description: Pulls the victim's soul into a vessel such as a mirror or gem, unless they pass Insight minus the power level. Power 1 holds it a shift, 2 a day, 3 forever or until a condition you set. Dispel Magic frees it; meanwhile the body lies senseless and open to other spirits.

Stats.Effect: Trap a soul in an object

entities.name: Befoul
entities.description: Rots one ration per power level into poison with a toxicity of three times the power level.

Stats.Effect: Turn food into poison

entities.name: Chill of the Grave
entities.description: Grave-cold seeps into the victim, who becomes cold and takes 1 damage to Strength and 1 stress to Wits now and each round until each totals the power level. No effect on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Cold, 1 damage and 1 stress each round

entities.name: Contaminate
entities.description: Gives a living humanoid a disease with a virulence of three times the power level.

Stats.Effect: A disease of virulence three times the power level

entities.name: Ghoulish Glare
entities.description: Your dreadful look fills a living humanoid with dread, dealing stress to Empathy equal to the power level.

Stats.Effect: Stress to Empathy equal to the power level

entities.name: Hand of Doom
entities.description: An unseen hand crushes the victim's heart for damage equal to the power level. One extra Willpower, adding no power, stretches the range to Medium. Only on living humanoids.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level

entities.name: Raise the Dead
entities.description: Wakes one dead humanoid or animal as a rank 1 undead, which keeps its Strength, loses 1 Agility, has no Wits or Empathy, and obeys simple orders. Each power level past the first raises one more or adds a rank to all of them; higher ranks can be stronger, smarter or last longer.

Stats.Effect: Raise rank 1 undead

entities.name: Speak to the Dead
entities.description: Near where someone died or lies, and knowing their name, ask them a few simple questions. The dead may not want to help. Not on undead.

Stats.Effect: Ask the dead a few questions

entities.name: Steal Life
entities.description: Drains living things around you for Willpower equal to twice the power level. It needs plants nearby, and every person, beast and plant in your zone dies.

Stats.Effect: Gain twice the power level in Willpower; all life in the zone dies

entities.name: Terror
entities.description: Visions of their own decay and death flood the victim, dealing stress to both Wits and Empathy equal to the power level. Only on living humanoids.

Stats.Effect: Stress to Wits and Empathy equal to the power level

entities.name: Combustion
entities.description: Makes a lifeless object burst into flame. A held item must be dropped or deals 1 damage; burning clothes or armour expose the wearer to fire with an intensity of twice the power level.

Stats.Effect: Set an object alight

entities.name: Sunder
entities.description: Breaks a lifeless, unmagical object: each power level takes 1 from its gear bonus or deals 10 damage to it. Armour gives no protection.

Stats.Effect: Break an object, -1 gear bonus per power level

entities.name: Suffocate
entities.description: Pulls the air from the victim's lungs: 1 damage at the start of each following round, as many rounds as the power level, ignoring armour. They can't speak or scream, and if broken by it die in D6 rounds without a Healing roll.

Stats.Effect: 1 damage each round for the power level in rounds

entities.name: Water Breathing
entities.description: You or someone you touch breathes water like air. Each power level adds one more creature or one more stretch, in any mix.

Stats.Effect: Breathe underwater

entities.name: Heat of the Moment
entities.description: Roll twice the power level in base dice, without pushing, against the victim's Insight. If you win, they go berserk and attack everyone near until broken or alone. No effect on monsters or beings without Wits.

Stats.Effect: Opposed roll to drive a victim berserk

entities.name: Rock Storm
entities.description: Hurls stones at a foe for damage equal to the power level. Armour works as usual.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level

entities.name: Flight
entities.description: A whirlwind lifts you to fly for a round, two zones per move. Casting is not an action. Each extra power level adds a round or carries another person.

Stats.Effect: Fly two zones per move for a round

entities.name: Parch
entities.description: Draws the water out of a living victim, dealing damage to Agility equal to the power level. Armour does not help.

Stats.Effect: Agility damage equal to the power level

entities.name: Fireball
entities.description: A ball of fire bursts on the target for damage equal to the power level, and everyone else in that zone faces fire with an intensity of twice the power level.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level, fire in the zone

entities.name: Stoneskin
entities.description: Living stone covers your body, giving an armour rating of twice the power level.

Stats.Effect: Armour rating twice the power level

entities.name: Tornado
entities.description: A whirlwind deals blunt damage equal to the power level, split as you like among targets in one zone. Everyone there must roll Might to keep their feet, and fliers to stay aloft.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level, split among a zone

entities.name: Flood Wave
entities.description: Nearby water or snow crashes over your foes as a wave or small avalanche. Split damage equal to the power level among them; anyone hurt falls down.

Stats.Effect: Damage equal to the power level, split, knocks down

entities.name: Entice
entities.description: Unless they pass Insight minus the power level, the victim spends their actions moving to the symbol. Reaching it or moving the symbol ends the spell. No effect on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Lure a victim to the symbol

entities.name: Horrify
entities.description: The symbol wakes a deep fear, dealing stress to Wits equal to the power level. No effect on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Stress to Wits equal to the power level

entities.name: Paralyze
entities.description: The symbol entrances a foe. Power 1 takes their fast action, 2 their slow action, 3 both, and 4 talent bonus actions as well. No effect on monsters.

Stats.Effect: The victim loses actions

entities.name: Blind
entities.description: Unless they pass Insight minus the power level, the victim is blinded as in total darkness. Beasts without Wits are blinded anyway; monsters are not.

Stats.Effect: Blind a victim

entities.name: Illusion
entities.description: One person sees or hears something false, or misses something real. A small thing needs power 1, a person-sized one 2, a house 3. They see through it with Insight minus the power level. No effect on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Show or hide something to one person

entities.name: Mind Trick
entities.description: An NPC absent-mindedly fails to do some small thing, such as checking who passes or picking up their keys. Not in combat.

Stats.Effect: Make an NPC skip a small action

entities.name: Puppeteer
entities.description: Unless they pass Insight minus the power level, you take over the victim's body for one fast and one slow action until their next turn; they can't react first. No effect on monsters.

Stats.Effect: Control the victim's next actions

entities.name: Power Rune
entities.description: Charges a drawn or carved rune with Willpower equal to the power level, to spend on later spells without Bind Magic. Other rune-casters who find it can use it too.

Stats.Effect: Store Willpower equal to the power level

entities.name: Portal
entities.description: Tears open a passage to another world, where demons and worse may wait; Bind Demon helps. It can also make a new portal from the far side leading anywhere.

Stats.Effect: Open a way to another world
